title: IoT communication system for a college department
meta: Team lead. NodeMCU ESP8266, MQTT, Python, Wi-Fi.
description: A department notification system built around a single NodeMCU that runs both the MQTT broker and the Wi-Fi hotspot, so no external router is needed and IP addresses stay stable. A smart keypad adds two-way acknowledgement, so a sender knows a message arrived.

title: Acoustic environment classification
meta: Team lead. Python, Google Colab, Random Forest and neural network.
description: Real-time classification of surrounding sound, built with MFCC feature extraction, standard scaling and PCA. Evaluated with accuracy, confusion matrix, precision, recall and F1-score. Presented at IEEE INNOVA-2024 and named Best Project of the Year at Open Day 2024–25.

title: Arduino prototypes
description: A density-based traffic light controller, an adaptive home lighting and heating system, and a contactless multi-position steering system with battery boosting from PV and TEG.
